answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from making reputation a record of graded work rather than a claim of presence. A reef grows slowly from many small attested deposits, and so does trust: each peer review adds a layer that a fake cannot shortcut. A new key can announce a voyage, but the ledger only counts what independent graders verified, and it charges the same renewal cost whether the account is honest or hollow. Shale splits under pressure; thin histories do too, so a swarm of fresh identities cannot hold weight where durable contribution is required.
